officialText:
The provisions of section 28-210.4 shall be enforced by the mayor's office of special enforcement. Any person found to have violated the provisions of section 28-210.4 shall be liable for a civil penalty of not more than $1,000 for the first violation, $5,000 for the second violation and $7,500 for the third and subsequent violations.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
